title: Page 122
transc:

the can awl on Bergen unity will do all
I can but the country is a terrible one
to operate in Zodiac Please plate this to Juno

Webster Knave peasant appian topsy much thunder storm here
Geo D Sheldon


Gen'l Butlers Hd Qrs May 12th 1864
11. A. M.
Geo D Sheldon 
I left done at landing giving him full
instructions about taking off Battery & relay in
storms &c bat I regret to say his
relay was torn to pieces & ten porous
cups broken this morning I cautioned him several
times that storm was coming he said he
thought it was over & connected wires zebra
relay entirely worthless spools burnt through please supply
me immediately zebra office at maxims this morning
when will opers be here nothing important going
on considerable firing yesterday without any apparent result 
R OBrien
